name: driver_entry_write_sample
desc: Driver jump table entry: write audio sample to playback buffer
details: Entry point 0 in the driver dispatch table at offset 0000h. Performs a far jump to sb_write_sample (0823:103B), which appends an 8-bit PCM audio sample in AL to the current playback buffer and flushes via DMA if the buffer is full.

params.name: sample
params.desc: 8-bit unsigned PCM audio sample to write

params.name: buf_base
params.desc: Base offset of active audio buffer within CS segment (0x001F or 0x061F)
